description: Get the 20 newest Google Maps reviews for a business: stars, text, date and the owner's reply, plus its overall score. Reviewer names and photos are removed. Use it when: You need to judge a local business's reputation or spot recurring complaints. Not for: Finding businesses (use Google Maps business search first) or online-only companies (use Trustpilot reviews). Returns: 20 reviews with stars, text, date and owner reply, plus the business's overall score and review count. No reviewer identities. Typical time: about 13 s. Price: $0.014 per search (up to 20 reviews), charged only on success. One call = up to 20 reviews.
